title: Render a greedy policy rollout
description: You collect grid images and rewards while following the largest Q entry at each state.

steps.description: You build a color image from WORLD and overwrite the current cell with the agent color. np.kron enlarges the cell image for display.
You reset the environment and collect a frame before each action. argmax selects from the current state's Q row, and each sampled reward adds to total.

steps.question: Does a terminal transition contribute a frame of its destination?
steps.answer: Yes. When done is true, the code renders the new state before breaking.

steps.description: You print the rollout return and save frames as a GIF when frames exist. The recording reports return -12.0 and the saved animation path.
